answer: AI agent networks prevent Sybil attacks using proof-of-stake tied to decentralized identity. Each agent binds its keypair to an on-chain identity anchor backed by locked assets. Spawning fake nodes forces attackers to deposit distinct collateral pools for every identity pearl, imposing an O(N) capital cost that renders mass identity generation economically unfeasible.
